description: The GATED driver-GREEN honest-verify live check, config-driven. The workspace is NOT hardcoded here , databricksHost is the REQUIRED ${DATABRICKS_HOST} marker, which driver-build-support.ts exports from the ONE config home (resolveTestEnv -> .env.local.test.config: DATABRICKS_CONFIG_PROFILE / LAKEBASE_TEST_HOST) before loading this. So the single source of the workspace is that config file, not this run-config. Same setup/teardown lifecycle kinds as the stockflow demo (scaffold-project / remove-project). The driver-GREEN turn runs on the uncontained live executor between these ops (see driver-build-support.ts).
